versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-kuaishou-competitor-research

- Enables keyword search of Kuaishou videos, creator post tracking, and comment fetching, with structured JSON output.
- Supports bulk data extraction (up to 10,000 items per query) for competitor monitoring, KOL discovery, content trends, and comment insight.
- Requires no Kuaishou account login, focusing solely on public data for safe use.
- Command routing based on input: keywords (video search), profile/user_id (creator posts), video link/ID (comments).
- Provides detailed error handling, usage boundaries, and integration guidelines for downstream analytics.
- Only supports public Kuaishou data; does not handle Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, private or hidden content.
